en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: sounds like a modern novokomponirana (newly composed) song, but I cannot name an author. 'Засвири една наша' means play one of our songs (my reading of 'наша' as 'our song').

lines.en: In my breast his picture,
here a tear runs down,

lines.cyr: да му каже дека уште живее во мене,
lines.lat: da mu kaže deka ušte živee vo mene,
lines.en: to tell him that he still lives in me,
to tell him: it is the same.

lines.cyr: Нека види дека уште сама сум, тагувам,
lines.lat: Neka vidi deka ušte sama sum, taguvam,
lines.en: Let him see that I am still alone, grieving,
he who wounds hearts.

lines.cyr: Засвири една наша Милане, за мене,
lines.lat: Zasviri edna naša Milane, za mene,
lines.en: Play one of ours, Milan, for me,
play, it will pass,
whoever never had a great love once,

lines.cyr: тој што нема душа не знае да тагува.
lines.lat: toj što nema duša ne znae da taguva.
lines.en: he who has no soul does not know how to grieve.
In me happiness is setting,
I find only sorrow.

lines.cyr: Една роза и без вода цутеше некогаш,
lines.lat: Edna roza i bez voda cuteše nekogaš,
lines.en: A rose even without water once bloomed,
now it has withered.

lines.cyr: Една роза и без сонце остана црвена,
lines.lat: Edna roza i bez sonce ostana crvena,
lines.en: A rose even without sun stayed red,
now frost is on it.

lines.cyr: Засвири една наша Милане, за мене,
lines.lat: Zasviri edna naša Milane, za mene,
lines.en: Play one of ours, Milan, for me,
play, it will pass,
whoever never had a great love once,

lines.cyr: тој што нема душа не знае да тагува.
lines.lat: toj što nema duša ne znae da taguva.
lines.en: he who has no soul does not know how to grieve.
Play for me, play gently, Milan,
so that it passes for me.
